annotations.title: Dutch transfer tax on buying a home

description: Overdrachtsbelasting in 2026 when buying a home in the Netherlands: 2% for a home you live in, 0% for first-time buyers aged 18-34 up to a €555,000 price, 8% for other homes.

first_time_starter_exemption.description: The buyer has never used the starters exemption. Default true.

own_home.description: The buyer will live in it as their main home. Default true.
